plugins.name: lingo-abroad
plugins.description: Like a language podcast or audio course, but it talks back: 7-minute voice lessons for travelers, from any language to any language. Polite phrases you'll say, what locals say back, the signs you'll see; 6 survival topics with roleplays, memory tricks, practice, tests and a progress card.
